study_area.name: dead_sea_east
study_area.title: Dead Sea - Jordanian east shore
study_area.story: The east shore between Suweimeh and Ghor Haditha, just north of the Lisan peninsula. Shoreline retreat as the lake level falls, and the sinkhole belt on the Ghor Haditha plain.
